thought_title: Three mysteries worked in God's silence

edition.witness_note: Lake 1912 Loeb copy-text; Lightfoot/Funk middle recension not yet locked as second witness

source_text: [1] Καὶ ἔλαθεν τὸν ἄρχοντα τοῦ αἰῶνος τούτου ἡ παρθενία Μαρίας καὶ ὁ τοκετὸς αὐτῆς, ὁμοίως καὶ ὁ θάνατος τοῦ κυρίου: τρία μυστήρια κραυγῆς, ἅτινα ἐν ἡσυχίᾳ θεοῦ ἐπράχθη. [2] πῶς οὖν ἐφανερώθη τοῖς αἰῶσιν; ἀστὴρ ἐν οὐρανῷ ἔλαμψεν ὑπὲρ πάντας τοὺς ἀστέρας, καὶ τὸ φῶς αὐτοῦ ἀνεκλάλητον ἦν καὶ ξενισμὸν παρεῖχεν ἡ καινότης αὐτοῦ, τὰ δὲ λοιπὰ πάντα ἄστρα ἅμα ἡλίῳ καὶ σελήνῃ χορὸς ἐγένετο τῷ ἀστέρι, αὐτὸς δὲ ἦν ὑπερβάλλων τὸ φῶς αὐτοῦ ὑπὲρ πάντα: ταραχή τε ἦν, πόθεν ἡ καινότης ἡ ἀνόμοιος αὐτοῖς. [3] ὅθεν ἐλύετο πᾶσα μαγεία καὶ πᾶς δεσμὸς ἠφανίζετο κακίας: ἄγνοια καθῃρεῖτο, παλαιὰ βασιλεία διεφθείρετο θεοῦ ἀνθρωπίνως φανερουμένου εἰς καινότητα ἀϊδίου ζωῆς: ἀρχὴν δὲ ἐλάμβανεν τὸ παρὰ θεῷ ἀπηρτισμένον. ἔνθεν τὰ πάντα συνεκινεῖτο διὰ τὸ μελετᾶσθαι θανάτου κατάλυσιν.
pass_a_gloss: And the virginity of Mary and her giving birth escaped the notice of the ruler of this age, as did also the death of the Lord: three mysteries of a loud cry, which were accomplished in the silence of God (1 Corinthians 2:8). How then was he revealed to the ages? A star shone in heaven beyond all the stars, and its light was beyond telling, and its newness caused amazement. All the rest of the stars, together with sun and moon, became a chorus to the star, but it was surpassing them all with its light. And there was confusion about where this newness, unlike them, came from. From then on all magic was being dissolved and every bond of wickedness was vanishing; ignorance was being torn down, the old kingdom was being destroyed, as God was being revealed in human fashion for the newness of eternal life. What had been made complete with God was taking its beginning. From then on all things were stirred together, because the destruction of death was being worked out.

lemmas.gloss: stir up together, set in motion
be practiced, be planned, be carried out

pass_b_english: Mary's virginity and her giving birth escaped the notice of the ruler of this age (1 Corinthians 2:8), and so, likewise, did the death of the Lord: three mysteries of a shout, which were done in the silence of God.

How, then, was he revealed to the ages? A star blazed in heaven, brighter than all the stars. Its light was beyond words, and its newness was astonishing. All the other stars, with the sun and the moon, gathered as a chorus around that star, but its light outshone them all. And there was confusion: where had this new thing come from, so unlike them?

From then on all magic was coming undone, and every chain of wickedness was vanishing. Ignorance was being torn down. The old kingdom was falling to ruin, as God was being revealed in human form for the newness of eternal life. What had been made complete with God was taking its beginning. And so all things were shaken together, because the destruction of death was under way.

choices.term: τρία μυστήρια κραυγῆς, ἅτινα ἐν ἡσυχίᾳ θεοῦ ἐπράχθη
choices.english: three mysteries of a shout, which were done in the silence of God
choices.why: Ignatius's paradox: mysteries of a cry, done in God's stillness. Passive ἐπράχθη kept; no purpose added.
rejected: mysteries of renown (ANF; loses the shout/silence contrast)

choices.why: τοκετός is the act of childbirth, not the child.

choices.english: because the destruction of death was under way
choices.why: Passive infinitive with no stated subject: the abolition of death was being carried out.
rejected: because He meditated the abolition of death (ANF; supplies a subject and narrows μελετάω to thinking)

choices.english: God was appearing in human form
choices.why: Genitive absolute; ἀνθρωπίνως means in a human way.
rejected: God Himself being manifested in human form (ANF; close)

anf_compare.notes: Mostly aligned. ANF 'her offspring' should be her giving birth (τοκετός); 'mysteries of renown' blunts κραυγῆς (a cry); 'He meditated the abolition of death' supplies a subject the passive infinitive μελετᾶσθαι does not have. 'so unlike to everything else [in the heavens]' adds a bracketed gloss.

bible_refs.note: ἀρχόντων τοῦ αἰῶνος τούτου: the rulers of this age did not know God's hidden wisdom

notes: Whole chapter 19 (sections 1-3) matches the ANF span.
Possible echoes kept out of the reading text: Romans 6:4 (newness of life, καινότητι ζωῆς); 2 Timothy 1:10 and 1 Corinthians 15:26 (death abolished); Genesis 37:9 (sun, moon, and stars bowing).
Matthew 2:2, 9 (the Magi's star) moved from inline to a possible allusion: the shared word is only ἀστήρ.

review.notes: Paragraph 1 (sections 1-3) checked clause by clause. 'Καὶ ἔλαθεν τὸν ἄρχοντα τοῦ αἰῶνος τούτου ἡ παρθενία Μαρίας καὶ ὁ τοκετὸς αὐτῆς, ὁμοίως καὶ ὁ θάνατος τοῦ κυρίου' matches Pass A 'escaped the notice of the ruler of this age, as did also the death of the Lord' and Pass B 'likewise, did the death of the Lord' (positive ὁμοίως καί; τοκετός kept as giving birth, not offspring). 'τρία μυστήρια κραυγῆς, ἅτινα ἐν ἡσυχίᾳ θεοῦ ἐπράχθη' matches 'three mysteries of a loud cry, which were accomplished in the silence of God' and 'three mysteries of a shout, which were done in the silence of God'. 'πῶς οὖν ἐφανερώθη τοῖς αἰῶσιν' is 'How then was he revealed to the ages' in both. Star, chorus, and confusion clauses are present, including 'χορὸς ἐγένετο τῷ ἀστέρι' / 'became a chorus to the star'; B's 'gathered as a chorus around that star' does not reverse that sense. Imperfects and 'θεοῦ ἀνθρωπίνως φανερουμένου εἰς καινότητα ἀϊδίου ζωῆς' stay a genitive absolute of God revealed humanly for eternal life's newness. 'διὰ τὸ μελετᾶσθαι θανάτου κατάλυσιν' stays subjectless passive in 'was being worked out' and 'was under way'. '(1 Corinthians 2:8)' is an added identification in the ruler-of-this-age sentence, not a false verse on the supplied wording. Title names the silence-mysteries thought, not only the locus.

Locked Greek paragraph 1 fully corresponds to Pass A and Pass B. Pass A includes the required inline citation (1 Corinthians 2:8) beside the allusion to the rulers of this age not knowing, matching the Greek τὸν ἄρχοντα τοῦ αἰῶνος τούτου. All clauses are preserved: the virginity and childbirth of Mary, the death of the Lord, the three mysteries of a cry in God's silence, the star's revelation, the confusion over its newness, the dissolution of magic and wickedness bonds, the tearing down of ignorance, the destruction of the old kingdom, the beginning of what was made complete with God, and the stirring of all things due to the destruction of death being worked out. Pass B accurately reflects Pass A without addition or contradiction. Title 'Three mysteries worked in God's silence' names the thought. Notes disclose OCR damage and uncertain readings per house rules. No omissions, distortions, or false citations found. All checks pass.
